name_reason: Already compliant. data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + graphics domain (FIGANI is the graphics animation subsystem; the sole accessor fd2_step_figani_pose_animation is tagged System=graphics) + figani_pose_anim_pose_idx descriptor accurately reflects role (current pose index in the FIGANI pose-loop) and data type (idx = byte counter/index). No Ghidra address residue; the trailing token is the domain word 'idx', not a hex address. Companion symbol at 0x540FC is named ..._subframe_idx, consistent.
purpose: FIGANI pose-loop current pose index: runtime byte counter that tracks which pose the free-running pose-loop animation is currently showing.
logic_summary: Module-global state for fd2_step_figani_pose_animation (the only accessor). Holds the current pose index in range 0..figani[+0]-1 (figani[+0] is the pose-count header that bounds the wrap). Used to index the per-pose metadata table at figani+8+pose_idx*4 (each entry's +6 byte is that pose's sub-frame count). The stepper INCs it once the active pose's sub-frames are exhausted, and stores 0 to reset/wrap when palette_op==0 or when it advances past the last pose. Paired with data_fd2_graphics_figani_pose_anim_subframe_idx @ 0x540FC (sub-frame within the current pose).
element_semantics: Single byte = current pose index (0-based) into the FIGANI stream's pose sequence; wrap bound is the pose-count header at figani+0. Read zero-extended (MOVZX) -> unsigned 8-bit.
